Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really excited to get the AtlasBridge pilot running. We're aiming to start a 60-day pilot next week (single seat, up to 2k tokens/day), and the procurement team here asked whether Redwood requires a Purchase Order for initial pilots. Our standard requires PO for committed spend, but for small trials we sometimes route via monthly invoices.

I've attached our W-9 and the SOW (draft). Can you confirm:
- Does Redwood require a PO for this pilot (estimated monthly spend ~$3,200)?
- If a PO is required, what is the onboarding timeline on your side?

If a PO would add delay, would Redwood accept a temporary invoice-only arrangement for the trial with an upper cap and Net30? If so, please outline any information you need from us (insurance, contact, forms).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want to align procurement with the kick-off.

Best,

Sean — thanks for the note and for sending the SOW/W9. Great to hear you're ready to start. Short answers up front: we can support a temporary invoice-only path for this pilot under a conditional approval (see below), which should avoid PO lead time and let you start sooner.

What we'll need from AtlasBridge to qualify for the temporary no-PO path:
- Signed SOW via DocuSign (link OK to use)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (legal name, EIN, remittance address)
- Current Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as an additional insured for the pilot period
- W-9 (received — thank you)

Operational guardrails we propose for the pilot (to protect both sides):
- Trial cap: $15,000 cumulative (two months) — we won't bill above this without a PO or written approval
- Single monthly invoice, Net30
- No auto-renewal into a billed subscription without either a PO or a signed amendment that includes payment terms

Next steps I suggest:
1) Marissa to send the DocuSign SOW to your signing contact (attached).
2) Sean to upload COI and vendor onboarding details (Priya will provide the onboarding link).
3) Priya to confirm conditional approval in writing once docs are complete.

Marissa — can you trigger the DocuSign and include our standard pilot addendum? Priya / David — can you confirm the proposed guardrails are acceptable from procurement/finance?

Thanks — happy to sync by quick call if helpful.

— Tessa Morgan

1) Once you confirm the conditional approval, can Redwood start provisioning the pilot before we issue a PO?
2) If we later convert to a paid subscription, is there a simple path to generate a PO on our side and attach it to the existing account (we want to avoid account duplication)?

Appreciate the flexibility — we want to avoid kick-off delay.

Subject: Conditional approval for invoice-only pilot (AtlasBridge)

Hi Sean — looping in procurement and finance to confirm conditional approval. Thanks for the quick turnaround on the COI and onboarding details earlier today.

After reviewing the documents we received, procurement and finance will approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding lane for AtlasBridge with the following written conditions (please treat these as binding for the pilot period):

1) Financial controls
- Pilot maximum: $15,000 total (no single invoice to exceed $10,000)
- Billing cadence: single invoice per calendar month, Net30
- Redwood will pause provisioning if cumulative invoiced amount approaches the cap until a PO or written authorization is provided

2) Documentation & compliance
- Signed SOW on DocuSign (link from Marissa) — received/attached copy is fine for intake
- Current Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference as additional insured for the pilot
- Completed vendor onboarding form with EIN and remittance details

3) Conversion to production
- Any conversion from pilot to a paid subscription over the $15k cap requires a formal PO and requisite procurement approval on both sides

We've attached a short conditional-no-po-form.pdf that you can sign to acknowledge the terms above (this is a lightweight record we use internally to track temporary exceptions). Once we have the signed form, COI, and the SOW executed, finance (David) will issue the written approval and Ops can proceed with provisioning.

David — please confirm finance's acceptance of Net30 and the single invoice flow.

Sean — if all good, please sign/return the attached conditional-no-po-form and we'll move forward. If you'd prefer a quick 15-minute call to confirm, happy to set one up today.

Thanks,
